name: Scott Turner

lean.basis: Republican member of the Texas House (2013–2017) who led Trump's Opportunity and Revitalization Council and is his HUD secretary.

summary: Scott Turner played nine NFL seasons as a defensive back, served two terms as a Republican in the Texas House, and in 2019 became executive director of Trump's White House Opportunity and Revitalization Council, which promoted opportunity zones. The Senate confirmed him as housing secretary 55–44 in February 2025.
